description: Tool to list all disputes from a Stripe account. Use when you need to retrieve disputes with optional filtering by charge or payment intent.

inputSchema.description: Request model for listing disputes, allowing filtering and pagination.

charge.description: Filter results to disputes linked to a specific charge ID.
charge.title: Charge

created.description: Filter disputes by creation date range using timestamps with keys 'gt', 'gte', 'lt', 'lte'.
created.title: Created

ending_before.description: A cursor for pagination; returns only disputes created before this object ID.
ending_before.title: Ending Before

limit.description: Number of objects to return (range: 1-100, default: 10).
limit.title: Limit

payment_intent.description: Filter results to disputes associated with a specific PaymentIntent ID.
payment_intent.title: Payment Intent

starting_after.description: A cursor for pagination; returns only disputes created after this object ID.
starting_after.title: Starting After
